short_intro: Result-first reader for named mathematical and physical work. The full index links each route’s formal basis, source record or check, and boundary where separately addressable.
Use this index to find the result page; use the full index and that page’s own linked records for the corresponding evidence.
full_intro: This is a result-first, source-indexed public reader. It distinguishes exact finite identities, field constructions, conditional formal theorems, local checks, and stated open adapters rather than collapsing them into one claim.
Each entry below is a discovery annotation. The linked pages and their cited records remain the authority for mathematical statements, pins, DOIs, statuses, and scope.
disclosures: A finite identity, field construction, conditional theorem, and measurement are distinct kinds of result.
Formal Correspondence is an annotation map beside source records; it is not a proof substitute.
This site does not derive or locally replay the external Riemann-Hypothesis theorem. It does not publish, link, or distribute the EARR-001 packet.
Development, draft receipt work, and held candidates are excluded from this sitemap and LLM discovery index.

routes.title: Gravity & Electromagnetism Field Map
routes.summary: A result-first map from one rank-four coframe to Lorentzian metric, oriented solder flux, electromagnetic curvature, and the stated regular-branch Einstein–Maxwell reduction.
routes.detail: The public field result is presented first: Π → (g, F_sol) → F_em, with its regular branch, finite checks, source paths, and named open adapters kept distinct.
routes.boundary: The original Int-valued SmoothCompletion constructor, P14 adapter, and selected spin-two readout remain separately named open items.

routes.title: Metric Minimum
routes.summary: An exactly typed coframe-to-metric-and-flux map, its regular Einstein–Maxwell reduction, and a signed 2×2 coordinate reader inside the field carrier.
routes.detail: Metric Minimum states the coframe, metric, flux, regular-branch reduction, reader, source files, and verification materials at their declared carriers.
routes.boundary: The page distinguishes the stated field construction from its separate conditional Lean boundary and open adapters.

routes.title: Einstein–Maxwell Field Closure on T³
routes.summary: A real C∞ Einstein–Maxwell field construction on compact boundaryless T³ with seven named roles, six secondary brackets, and a separate Lean boundary.
routes.detail: The construction records its seven field roles and six canonical secondary brackets, then separates the classical construction from the conditional Lean theorem and remaining obligations.
routes.boundary: The Lean theorem is conditional on the named SmoothCompletion roles; the original constructor and P14 adapter remain open.

routes.boundary: Reported checks and runnable finite verifiers do not turn named open adapters into proved results.

routes.boundary: Library inclusion is a reading and source index, not a replacement for a work’s own result, version, or verification record.
